title: Find the display name of the most influential user (highest reputation) who
question: Find the display name of the most influential user (highest reputation) who has placed a bounty of 50 on any post with 'variance' in its title, and calculate what percentage of their posts have a score above 50.

prediction.sql:
WITH BountyUsers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_052 AS UserId
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
    WHERE p.XCL_039 = 50
      AND p.XCL_035 LIKE '%variance%'
),
TargetUser AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_052 AS UserId, u.XCL_055 AS DisplayName
    FROM users u
    WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT UserId FROM BountyUsers)
    ORDER BY u.XCL_053 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
UserPostStats AS (
    SELECT
        tu.DisplayName,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalPosts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_031 > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HighScorePosts
    FROM TargetUser tu
    INNER JOIN posts p ON tu.UserId = p.XCL_033
    GROUP BY tu.DisplayName
)
SELECT
    DisplayName,
    CAST(HighScorePosts AS REAL) * 100 / TotalPosts AS PercentageHighScore
FROM UserPostStats;

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH BountyUsers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_052 AS UserId
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
    WHERE p.XCL_039 = 50
      AND p.XCL_035 LIKE '%variance%'
),
TargetUser AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_052 AS UserId, u.XCL_055 AS DisplayName
    FROM users u
    WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT UserId FROM BountyUsers)
    ORDER BY u.XCL_053 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
UserPostStats AS (
    SELECT
        tu.DisplayName,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalPosts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_031 > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HighScorePosts
    FROM TargetUser tu
    INNER JOIN posts p ON tu.UserId = p.XCL_033
    GROUP BY tu.DisplayName
)
SELECT
    DisplayName,
    CAST(HighScorePosts AS REAL) * 100 / TotalPosts AS PercentageHighScore
FROM UserPostStats;

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
WITH BountyUsers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_052 AS UserId
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
    WHERE p.XCL_039 = 50
      AND p.XCL_035 LIKE '%variance%'
),
TargetUser AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_052 AS UserId, u.XCL_055 AS DisplayName
    FROM users u
    WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT UserId FROM BountyUsers)
    ORDER BY u.XCL_053 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
UserPostStats AS (
    SELECT
        tu.DisplayName,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalPosts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_031 > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HighScorePosts
    FROM TargetUser tu
    INNER JOIN posts p ON tu.UserId = p.XCL_033
    GROUP BY tu.DisplayName
)
SELECT
    DisplayName,
    CAST(HighScorePosts AS REAL) * 100 / TotalPosts AS PercentageHighScore
FROM UserPostStats;

It then calculates the percentage of that user's posts with a score above 50 (posts.XCL_031). The empty result set is a factual observation of the database state (no user meets the specific bounty/title criteria), not a semantic error in the query logic. The bindings for display name (XCL_055), reputation (XCL_053), bounty (XCL_039), title (XCL_035), and score (XCL_031) are supported by historical evidence and physical samples.

Selection: Most influential user (highest reputation). Correctly implemented via ORDER BY u.XCL_053 DESC LIMIT 1 on the eligible users.

Measure: Percentage of the target user's posts with score > 50. Correctly implemented by joining the target user to all their posts and calculating CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_031 > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*).
Output: Display name and percentage. Correctly projected as DisplayName and PercentageHighScore.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH TargetUser AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_052 AS UserId, u.XCL_055 AS DisplayName
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_040
    WHERE p.XCL_030 = 50
      AND p.XCL_035 LIKE '%variance%'
    ORDER BY u.XCL_053 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
UserPostStats AS (
    SELECT
        tu.DisplayName,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalPosts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_039 > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HighScorePosts
    FROM TargetUser tu
    INNER JOIN posts p ON tu.UserId = p.XCL_033
    GROUP BY tu.DisplayName
)
SELECT
    DisplayName,
    (HighScorePosts * 100.0 / TotalPosts) AS PercentageHighScore
FROM UserPostStats;
